service.description: Moves the end of the demo quotes' validity to the load: BOSS_SAL_QTE_WINGTIP's to 77 days and BOSS_SAL_QTE_FABRIKAM's to 105 days after the load day at 00:00 (a load on Nov 15, 2026 gives Jan 31 and Feb 28, 2027), so both are open whenever the demo is loaded; loading again moves them, and a missing quote is logged and skipped. Only data loading or a system administrator may run it.
